sp: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY SEQ, JOB_ID ) AS NUM,

params:
{"PROG_ID": "find_FP01820_Sub", "QUERY_ID": "FP\ADMIN\FP01820_Net_Job", "QUERY_SEQ": "0", "INST_SEQ": "0", "QUERY_VALUE": "---Service Parameter : 0GROUP_NAME
---Service Parameter : 1GROUP_ID
---Service Parameter : 2DIVISION_ID
---Service Parameter : 3VALID_YN
---Check client parameter : GROUP_ID
---FOUND GROUP_ID
-- TYPE = nvarchar---Add string Service
---Check client parameter : GROUP_NAME
---FOUND GROUP_NAME
-- TYPE = nvarchar---Add string Service
---Check client parameter : DIVISION_ID
---FOUND DIVISION_ID
-- TYPE = nvarchar---Add string Service
---Check client parameter : VALID_YN
---FOUND VALID_YN
-- TYPE = nvarchar---Add string Service
---Check client parameter : USER_ID

          SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY SEQ, JOB_ID ) AS NUM,
                 GROUP_ID, DIVISION_ID, JOB_ID, JOB_DESC, JOB_TYPE, NO, NO AS ORG_NO, SEQ, JOB_ID AS ORG_JOB_ID,
                 VALID, STATUS, ERROR_MSG, @GROUP_NAME AS GROUP_NAME,
                 CONVERT(VARCHAR, START_DATE, 120) AS START_DATE,
                 CONVERT(VARCHAR, END_DATE, 120) AS END_DATE,
                 PARAMETER1, PARAMETER2, PARAMETER3, PARAMETER4, PARAMETER5,
                 CREATE_USER_ID, CONVERT(VARCHAR, CREATE_DATE, 120) CREATE_DATE,
                 MODIFY_USER_ID, CONVERT(VARCHAR, MODIFY_DATE, 120) MODIFY_DATE,
                 (SELECT ERROR_MSG
                 FROM (
                     SELECT ERROR_MSG, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY IF_SEQ DESC) AS RSEQ
                     FROM JOB_SCHEDULE_HISTORY T WITH(NOLOCK)
                     WHERE T.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                     AND T.JOB_ID = A.JOB_ID
                     AND T.GROUP_ID = A.GROUP_ID
                     AND ERROR_MSG IS NOT NULL
                 ) AS B
                 WHERE B.RSEQ <= 1) AS HIS_ERROR_MSG
          FROM  JOB_SCHEDULE_DETAIL A WITH(NOLOCK)
          
          WHERE GROUP_ID    = @GROUP_ID
          AND   DIVISION_ID = @DIVISION_ID
          AND (VALID = ISNULL(@VALID_YN,'') OR ISNULL(@VALID_YN,'')='ALL' OR ISNULL(@VALID_YN,'')='')
          ORDER BY SEQ, JOB_ID
        ", "JOB_TYPE": "read", "START_TIME": "2026-11-12 19:20:12", "END_TIME": "2026-11-12 19:20:15", "INSERT_ID": "jaeuk.shin", "LOG_TYPE": "SQL", "IP_ADDRESS": "100.113.200.36", "SESSION_ID": "20261112192012_11", "PARAM_VALUE": "{GROUP_ID : 40_0001 GROUP_NAME : FP DEMAND PEGGING RUN(CN) DIVISION_ID : 40 VALID_YN : ALL USER_ID : nil }", "DUR_TIME": "623", "ATTRIBUTE1": "GeneralExecuteQuery", "ATTRIBUTE2": "", "ATTRIBUTE3": "", "ATTRIBUTE4": "", "ATTRIBUTE5": ""}
